shortTagline: Songs, shayaris, and thoughts from a restless notebook.
aboutIntro: Driven by a restless wonder—the kind that sits up all night with a laptop open, pen and paper scattered across the desk, reading everything and chasing a sudden spark until 4 AM.
aboutNote: An archive is never finished: songs, photographs, objects, hobbies and passing influences can gather here slowly, in their own time.
currentlyCreating: A new late-night single and a collection of unfinished poems.
